purpose: Approved, public-safe sales methodology for St. Mary's admissions. Institutional facts such as fees, current deadlines, scholarships, seat availability and current results must come from the private institute knowledge bundle.

principles.name: Listen before recommending
principles.rule: Understand the family's goal, concern, comparison criteria, timing and decision stage before recommending.

principles.name: Adapt, do not read a rigid script
principles.rule: Use a consistent process but adapt wording and order to the lead, programme, concern and funnel stage.

principles.name: Diagnostic questions
principles.rule: Ask relevant questions naturally. Do not optimize for a fixed question count or interrogate.

principles.name: Reflect and summarize
principles.rule: Briefly paraphrase important needs or concerns and allow correction before recommending.

principles.name: Clarify objections with ACAN
principles.rule: Acknowledge -> Clarify when needed -> Answer factually -> Next step/check. Never use clarification to evade a direct factual question.

principles.name: Transparent concise opening
principles.rule: Identify St. Mary's and the reason for calling promptly; earn permission to continue. Exact opener length remains a local experiment.

principles.name: Map value to the stated goal
principles.rule: Need/goal -> relevant approved St. Mary's fact -> why it matters -> suitable next step. Avoid feature dumps.

principles.name: Truth and fit
principles.rule: Do not force every lead toward admission. Never invent rankings, results, scholarships, scarcity, deadlines, guarantees or competitor claims.

principles.name: Tone and pacing
principles.rule: Coach clarity, warmth, pace, emphasis, pauses and filler reduction without forcing an artificial sales voice.

principles.name: Explicit next step
principles.rule: Qualified conversations should normally end with a clear next action appropriate to the funnel stage.

principles.name: Follow-up discipline
principles.rule: Meaningful calls should leave current status, needs/objections, next action and next-action date/time when applicable.

principles.name: Preserve autonomy
principles.rule: Respect questions, comparisons, later requests, no decisions and opt-outs. Guide rather than dominate.

call_flow.name: Open transparently
call_flow.rule: Identify St. Mary's, reason for call and check whether it is suitable to continue when appropriate.

call_flow.name: Establish relevance
call_flow.rule: Confirm programme/grade/context and why the conversation may matter.

call_flow.name: Discover
call_flow.rule: Understand goals, decision criteria, concerns, timing and decision context with targeted questions.

call_flow.name: Reflect
call_flow.rule: Summarize the family's priorities and let them correct the understanding.

call_flow.name: Recommend selectively
call_flow.rule: Use only approved current facts that map directly to the stated need.

call_flow.name: Handle objections with ACAN
call_flow.rule: Acknowledge, clarify if needed, answer factually, then check or agree the next step.

call_flow.name: Close for the right next step
call_flow.rule: Choose the appropriate commitment: visit, counselling, information plus scheduled callback, application, confirmation or respectful close.

call_flow.name: Update CRM
call_flow.rule: Record outcome, needs, objections, information provided, next action and follow-up date/time where applicable.

prohibited_patterns: fear, shame or pressure about the student's future
repeated pressure after a clear no
unverified result, ranking, scholarship or guarantee claims
pressure to borrow or stretch beyond a stated affordability concern
refusing direct factual questions to retain control
assuming generic internet talk/listen ratios or question counts are mandatory

coaching.rule: Coach one or two high-impact behaviours at a time.
sequence: play or quote the exact moment
listen for the behaviour in future calls
track whether the downstream metric improves

detect_when: a parent asks a factual institute question for which no approved current answer is available
the agent encounters an objection or situation not covered by the approved playbook
the transcript reveals conflicting, ambiguous or possibly stale institutional information
the agent needs a policy, escalation path or approved claim that is absent
knowledge_gap_rule.do_not_gap_when: The answer is already present in approved sales methodology or the private approved institute facts.
